answer: I would anchor trust in Verified butcher apprenticeship record with butchers guild attestation. With an apprenticeship the guild recorded across years of shops, a single lagoon check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the glacier compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the karst of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
